newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips end higher despite late selling.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips end higher despite late selling.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed firmer Thursday but just shy of a record as late selling slashed the market's gains from an extended "Santa Claus" rally.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed up 23.83 points at 6,546.68. Earlier, the index surged more than 40 points, surpassing its its record close of 6,547.79 set on Nov. 25.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 15-8 on light volume of 242 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
